name: Anara
long_description:
Anara is AI for scientific advancement. We help researchers find, understand and write scientific documents, together.

We started working on Anara two years ago. In that time:
- we’ve grown to 3M users spanning hundreds of major colleges and research-led companies,
- we are fast approaching $10M in yearly revenue,
- 600M+ people have seen our content across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube,
- and we raised $3M from YC and the founders of Github and Reddit.

We're a small, tight-knit team with huge ambitions. As a founding member, you'll be instrumental in helping us scale revenue from $10M to $100M and then $100M to $1B+.

If you’re excited by the idea of being a part of that, definitely reach out.

launches.title: Unriddle — AI research assistant for industry and academic research
launches.tagline: Read, write and organize research papers really quickly.
launches.body:
Hey YC - [Naveed](https://twitter.com/naveedjanmo) from [Unriddle](https://www.unriddle.ai/?utm_campaign=yclaunch) here. We help industry and academic researchers read, write, and organize research papers really quickly.

We launched just over a year ago, and today, we have 1.3M users, including teams at Johns Hopkins, Stanford University, and Roche Pharmaceutical.

Try it here: [unriddle.ai](https://www.unriddle.ai/?utm_campaign=yclaunch)

### **Problem**

Understanding the key themes, findings, and gaps in a field often involves sifting through hundreds of research papers. It’s a time-consuming and disorganized process.

And when working across multiple disciplines, researchers may lack the contextual or domain knowledge needed to fully grasp a paper’s significance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83362&key=user_uploads/1365789/20c1dfde-aa65-4195-b034-672f74d6d2d4)

### **Solution**

Unriddle uses language models to help researchers quickly and deeply understand papers, write literature reviews, prepare citations, and keep the entire research team on the same page.

It understands the context behind your research – synthesizing relevant findings, highlighting connections between papers, and suggesting related studies you might have missed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83362&key=user_uploads/1365789/4a10250b-cd45-4731-bce7-5c93d3ae2322)

### **Ask**

If you read or write research papers in any capacity, [try Unriddle](https://www.unriddle.ai/?utm_campaign=yclaunch) and let me know what you think at [naveed@unriddle.ai](mailto:naveed@unriddle.ai).

Intros to research teams, particularly those in life sciences (e.g., biotech, pharma, and healthcare).

— Naveed
